pos.personaBrief: Inter absorbed pressure, then countered with Suarez's long balls to Jair and Mazzola; Mazzola says opponents played in their own half at home, but the identity was counter-attacking.

pro.personaBrief: Suarez sat deep and hit long balls, and Herrera wanted few, very quick passes to goal with almost no dribbling; the safe holding midfielder (Tagnin, Bedin) fits.

est.personaBrief: Defined roles (libero, man-markers, attacking left-back, deep playmaker) and a stable XI point to a positional, rehearsed structure with players on set lines.

lar.personaBrief: Width came from Facchetti's overlapping runs, Jair on the right and Corso on the left; the attack was not centrally congested.

blo.personaBrief: Man-marking back line with a libero, a compact block that absorbed pressure and countered; five goals conceded in nine European games, with the opponent's half left alone.

mar.personaBrief: Sources agree on man-to-man marking with a spare libero behind; individual assignments were the core of the system.

pla.personaBrief: Herrera planned meticulously and stayed back more away from home in Europe, but imposed his libero and counter model on arrival and kept it at level scores.

res.personaBrief: Catenaccio-based, result-first: 1-0 Benfica final, 'we only need one goal', a pragmatic approach to winning rather than beauty.

sis.personaBrief: A rigid collective with the ritiro, set roles and everyone working, including stars like Suarez and Mazzola in the system; Herrera called style a limitation, not a talent show.

jog.personaBrief: Herrera said passion and strength are football words and demanded physical conditioning, but the team also relied on Suarez's passing and Corso's skill.

bas.personaBrief: A team built through signings (Suarez, Jair, Peiro) and a stable experienced XI; the academy was not a priority and Herrera sold off or discarded players freely.

lid.personaBrief: Herrera was the conducator: ritiro, strict control, the boss who sacked Picchi when he challenged him, though he used confessions with individuals.
